info.title: FitBook API
info.description: Backend for FitBook: coach catalog, availability, individual and group bookings (single and recurring), free trial, mock payments, notes and realtime chat. All dates are ISO 8601 UTC; money is integer cents.

id.description: Send it back to POST /auth/verify and /auth/verify/resend.

get.summary: Health check

post.summary: Register with email and password (role and home area required). Emails a 6-digit code; tokens come from POST /auth/verify.
post.description: An email of an unverified account is not taken: that account is overwritten with the new data and its previous codes stop working.

post.summary: Check email and password and email a 6-digit code (purpose "login", or "signup" for an unverified email). Tokens come from POST /auth/verify.
Check the emailed code and start a session
post.description: Errors in order: NOT_FOUND (unknown id), VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED (used, code older than 10 minutes or verification older than 30 minutes), TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS (5 wrong codes; a resend resets it), VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID (details.attemptsLeft). A signup verification also confirms the email.

post.summary: Email a new code for the same verification (old code stops working, attempts reset)
post.description: Allowed from resendAvailableAt (60 seconds after each send), at most 5 times. Too early -> RATE_LIMITED with details.retryAfterSeconds. Used, expired or resend limit reached -> VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED (sign in / sign up again).

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token (no email code). New accounts must complete POST /me/onboarding.
Sign in with an Apple identity token (no email code). New accounts must complete POST /me/onboarding.
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens (rotation; reuse revokes the session family)
Revoke a refresh token
Email a 6-digit reset code (always 204, no user enumeration)
Verify the reset code and get a short-lived reset token
Set a new password with the reset token: signs out all sessions, confirms the email and starts a new session (no extra code)

patch.summary: Change or set password (current password required if one exists). Signs out all other sessions and returns a new token pair for this device.

put.description: One review per client per coach. Creating needs at least one completed training with the coach (REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED). It can be changed during 24 hours after creation (REVIEW_EDIT_WINDOW_PASSED), not deleted. Coach rating is recalculated from the reviews.

post.description: Individual: `{sessionTypeId, startAt, isTrial?, useCredits?, location?}`. Group: `{sessionId, useCredits?}`. Paid bookings start as `pending_payment` and are released if not paid in time; the free trial and bookings paid with a credit (`useCredits: true`, NO_CREDITS if none) are confirmed immediately.

post.summary: Pay all pending bookings of a series (mock payment)

get.summary: Booking details (client or coach of the booking)

post.summary: Pay a pending booking (mock payment)
Cancel my booking (confirmed bookings only within the coach's free-cancellation window)
Move my booking to another time (individual) or another group session (group)
post.description: Individual: `{startAt}` - a free slot of the same training type (as returned by /coaches/:id/slots; the booking's own slot does not block it). Group: `{sessionId}` - another upcoming group session of the same type with free places. Allowed while `reschedulable` (same window as cancelling). Payment, trial, price, notes, location and series stay; the old slot / place is released.

get.summary: Event data for adding the training to the device calendar

post.summary: Cancel a booking of mine with a reason (any time before the start)
Mark the client as a no-show (from the start until 48 hours later)
post.description: `refund: true` returns the payment like a coach cancellation (a credit goes back to its package); `refund: false` keeps it. Ignored for trial / free bookings. Group sessions: per participant booking.

delete.summary: Remove a no-show (only without a refund, inside the 48-hour window)

get.summary: A recurring series: pattern, all bookings, upcoming count and whether it can be extended

post.summary: Cancel every upcoming booking of the series (same rules as one cancellation)
post.description: Bookings past their deadline are kept and listed in `kept`. None cancelled -> 409.

post.summary: Preview moving all movable upcoming bookings to new weekdays / time
post.description: Movable bookings (reschedulable, by start) are paired in order with the first dates of the new pattern from `startDate`. No movable booking -> RESCHEDULE_WINDOW_PASSED.

post.summary: Move all movable upcoming bookings to new weekdays / time (taken dates stay unchanged)
Preview extending the series by N weeks from extendFrom (same format as the series preview)
Extend the series: book the chosen dates into the same series
post.description: Like POST /bookings/series: new bookings are pending_payment (pay with /bookings/series/:id/pay) or confirmed with useCredits.

post.summary: Join the waitlist of a full upcoming group session
post.description: When a place frees up it is held for the first waiting client until min(now + 2h, start - 15 min) (`status: offered`, Socket.IO `waitlist:offered`); they book it with the usual POST /bookings { sessionId }.

delete.summary: Leave the waitlist (an offer passes to the next client)
